QuestInfo.name: A Present for Nero
QuestInfo.0: I need to see Elma the Housekeeper, who is in Orbis.
QuestInfo.1: You need to find the materials to make a gift for Ericsson's cat.
QuestInfo.2: Elma prepared a gift for Nero. Deliver the gift to Ericsson.

0.0: Ericsson wants a gift for his cat? Oh, did he specifically ask for #t4031199#?
0.1: Ericsson blew you off to hang out with his cat? Hmm... Then how about this? Make a small present for his cat Nero. Ericsson will then be happy enough to make you one.

no.0: I understand... Please come back if you change your mind.

yes.0: Here it is. Ericsson will love it for sure.
